author: 5unR4yDK (https://github.com/5unR4yDK)
_comment_overrides: next pins postcss and sharp internally at versions with published advisories; these force the patched releases across the tree. The brace-expansion entry is scoped to the 5.x instance under typescript-eslint so minimatch@3 keeps its own 1.x. Remaining audit findings are dev-only and sit under eslint 9 — eslint 10 fixes them but eslint-config-next's bundled eslint-plugin-react calls context.getFilename(), removed in v10, so the upgrade breaks linting. Revisit when eslint-config-next supports eslint 10.
